face_screening: No recognition, identity matching, embeddings, or biometric storage. Only face presence is checked. Imperfect, especially for small, obscured, rotated, and side-on faces. Thirteen scans improve coverage but provide no guarantee.
pool_observations: Deterministic colour observations limited to a user-confirmed water area; not a trained pool-diagnosis model.
backend: TensorFlow.js CPU; library, manifest, and detector weights are served by this website.
